question: Which of the following shortcut key is used to copy the selected data in MS-Word 365?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ctrl + C**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ctrl + C **is a universal keyboard shortcut on Microsoft systems that copies the selected text or item to the clipboard.
 
• **This shortcut is used across many applications, not just MS Word.**
 
• This includes other** Microsoft Office applications, browsers, and file explorer.**
 
• The copied data can then be pasted elsewhere using the keyboard shortcut **Ctrl + V.**
 
• This is a quicker and more efficient way of copying data than using the mouse to select** 'Copy' from the right-click context menu or from the 'Edit' menu in the toolbar.**
 
• It's also worth noting that the original data remains in place after the copy operation, allowing it to be copied to multiple locations if desired.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Shortcut Key
 Function
 
 
 
 

 Ctrl + X
 
 
This shortcut key is used to cut the selected text or item.

 
The cut item can then be pasted elsewhere using Ctrl + V.

 
Unlike copy, the cut operation removes the original data from its initial location.

 
 
 

 Alt + C
 
 
This is not a standard shortcut in MS Word 365 or most other applications.

 
It could potentially be set as a custom shortcut, but by default, it does not perform any function.

 
 
 

 Alt + X
 
 
This is also not a standard shortcut in MS Word 365.

 
As with Alt + C, it could potentially be assigned a function in a custom setup, but by default, it does not perform any function.
